min_gpa_host.notes: Soka University inbound exchange FAQs note no strict central institutional minimum GPA requirement (relies on partner home nomination).

english_course_availability.notes: English-taught elective undergraduate courses available alongside Japanese-taught courses and Japanese language classes (ES-E5).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Students with TOEFL iBT 71 or above are eligible to enroll in elective undergraduate classes taught in English (2022 Fact Sheet #page=3). No RHET 1020 exemption stated.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Soka University/Fact Sheet Spring semeter 2022_Soka University.pdf#page=3

host_language_requirement.value: JLPT N2 or above required for elective undergraduate courses taught in Japanese; no prior Japanese required for English-taught courses or beginner ES-E5 Japanese language classes (up to 8 credits/semester).
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Soka University/Fact Sheet Spring semeter 2022_Soka University.pdf#page=3

fall_term_dates.value: Fall semester (AY 2026-2027 reference): Orientation ~11 Sep 2026, classes begin ~12 Sep 2026, final exams late Jan 2027 (official term dates mid-Sep - late Jan).

spring_term_dates.value: Spring semester (AY 2026-2027 reference): Early Apr (e.g. 6 Apr) - late Jul; dorm move-out early Aug.

tuition_model.notes: Tuition fees are fully waived for official exchange students from partner universities.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Soka University publishes dormitory fees (184,000-224,000 JPY/semester), optional cafeteria meal plan (22,500-24,300 JPY/month), and COE bank proof minimums (300,000 JPY/semester), but no all-in monthly living cost estimate on soka.ac.jp.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: Cannot be derived without an official Soka University all-in monthly living cost range.

housing_availability.notes: International student dormitories preferentially house exchange students (fee waivers may apply depending on bilateral agreement; 2022 Fact Sheet #page=7 noted dormitories fee-exempt for exchange students).

housing_notes.value: International dormitories preferentially house exchange students (https://www.soka.ac.jp/en/admissions/accommodation): Takiyama International Dormitory (on campus, single rooms, JPY 224,000/sem), Hoyu Dormitory (male, ~20 min walk, twin rooms, JPY 184,000/sem), plus Cosmos / Yuko / Manyo dormitories for female students. Standard entrance fee JPY 50,000; bilateral agreements may waive dorm fees (2022 Fact Sheet #page=7 noted dormitories fee-exempt for exchange students). Optional dorm cafeteria meal plan (Mon-Sat breakfast & dinner): JPY 24,300/month on soka.ac.jp (JPY 22,500/month in 2022 Fact Sheet #page=7).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Requires Certificate of Eligibility (COE) processed via Soka University prior to Japanese embassy student visa application. Mandatory financial proof: bank statement showing >= JPY 300,000 (1 semester) or >= JPY 600,000 (2 semesters).

credit_system_and_load.value: Minimum load of 7 classes per week (at least 10 hours / 600 minutes per week, 90 min/class) required; each UG course is 2-4 credits and Japanese language courses are 1-2 credits (up to 8 credits/semester).
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Soka University/Fact Sheet Spring semeter 2022_Soka University.pdf#page=3
